request_payload.title: Evaluation of the PP6D5 Polymer as a Novel Non-Viral Vector in the Development of a CRISPR/nCas9-Based Gene Therapy for Tay-Sachs Disease.

mentions.mention: β-hexosaminidase A deficiency with GM2 ganglioside accumulation
mentions.sentence: Tay-Sachs disease (TSD) is a neurodegenerative disorder caused by a deficiency in β-hexosaminidase A (HexA), which accumulates GM2 gangliosides, primarily in neurons.
